story.titleZh: FIA极限H世界杯第二赛季推迟至2027年
story.summaryZh: 原定于2026年10月29日至31日在沙特阿拉伯吉迪亚城举行的FIA极限H世界杯第二赛季因筹备过程中的物流和运营挑战而被推迟至2027年。
story.originalTitle: 🚨 BREAKING NEWS 🚨 The second edition of the FIA Extreme H World Cup, originally scheduled to take place in Qiddiya City, Saudi Arabia from 29–3...
story.summaryEn:
🚨 BREAKING NEWS 🚨
The second edition of the FIA Extreme H World Cup, originally scheduled to take place in Qiddiya City, Saudi Arabia from 29–31 October 2026, has been postponed until 2027.
The decision has been taken due to logistical and operational challenges affecting preparations for the event.
The FIA and Extreme H remain committed to working with their partners in Saudi Arabia to deliver the second edition of the World Cup in 2027.
#FIA #ExtremeH
https://www.fia.com/news/fia-and-extreme-h-confirm-postponement-second-edition-fia-extreme-h-world-cup-2027
detailZh:
🚨 突发新闻 🚨
FIA Extreme H世界杯的第二届比赛，原定于2026年10月29日至31日在沙特阿拉伯的吉迪亚城举行，现已推迟至2027年。
这一决定是由于影响赛事准备工作的物流和运营挑战而做出的。
FIA和Extreme H仍然致力于与沙特阿拉伯的合作伙伴合作，确保2027年成功举办世界杯第二届。
#FIA #ExtremeH

Celebrating a major milestone in automotive technology! ⚡🏁
Congratulations to BYD and YANGWANG on the U9 Xtreme achieving a remarkable top speed of 503.17 km/h, becoming the first production car to surpass the 500 km/h barrier.
The FIA is proud to recognise this achievement, highlighting BYD’s continued innovation and contribution to shaping the future of road car technology 👏
